links.outcome: Referral safety (recommending professional consultation) in suspected oral cancer scenarios
links.effect: Overall referral safety high (Gemini 90.0%; Grok 92.1%); Gemini failed to recommend professional consultation in two high-risk suspected malignancy scenarios, Grok consistently referred.
links.quote: Overall referral safety was high (Gemini: 90.0%; Grok: 92.1%), although the Gemini model failed to recommend professional consultation in two high-risk scenarios involving suspected malignancy.

links.outcome: Internal consistency of LLM responses across repeated daily prompts
links.effect: Internal consistency high for both models (Gemini α = 0.942; Grok α = 0.886); inter-model agreement moderate (ICC 0.50-0.58).
links.quote: Internal consistency was high for both models (Gemini α = 0.942; Grok α = 0.886), whereas inter-model agreement was moderate (ICC: 0.50-0.58).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the clinical safety, referral appropriateness, consistency, and readability of two LLMs (Gemini and Grok) using simulated patient scenarios in oral oncology, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
